scene: The red lever raises three glowing departure gates across the wide deck.
picture: Flat side view on the breezy platform deck. On the far left sits a tall glass elevator with open doors. Left of centre, a South Asian girl in a teal hoodie sits in her purple wheelchair beside the yellow pitkart. At the right waits a brass steam train. On the far right rests an indigo star shuttle.
shown: a cylindrical transparent glass elevator shaft on the far left with sliding doors open
a brass-striped steam train puffing candy-scented vapor at a platform on the right
a sleek indigo star shuttle with a lowered ramp parked on the far right

variants.scene: Three colorful energy turnstiles hum alive under the sparkling twilight sky.
